entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Manuel Eugenio Larrabure y Unanue was a Peruvian politician, diplomat, writer, historian and journalist. He was thrice Minister of Foreign Affairs, Minister of Development and Public Works, President of the Council of Ministers (1902–1903) and First Vice President.
